title: Frozen held-out validation of radix selection by empirical product-address cost

source_sweep.selection_rule: Within each predetermined {E3C3,E3C4} x {endpoint_cover,curvefp_ceil_absmax} cell, choose the reduced same-H pair whose higher-r member is within +5% aggregate mean scalar NMSE, is no worse in aggregate max NMSE and clipping, has lower occupied bins / higher duplicate rate / lower address entropy on all four source product traces, and has the largest occupied-bin decrease. No held-out result may add, remove, or replace a pair.

quantization.scale_policy_note: endpoint_cover is an engineering variation retained unchanged from the source sweep; it is not presented as CurveFP's dynamic scale policy.

non_counting_calibration_pair.rule: A large routed-cost advantage here is an instrumentation warning; it never counts toward validation.

prompts: Closed logarithmic arithmetic should be evaluated on real transformer GEMMs.
A reusable trace preserves operand topology while allowing radix sweeps.
Block scales separate local quantization density from coarse dynamic range.
Accumulation cost depends on product-address occupancy and locality.
held_out_capture.requirement: A complete exact-revision pretrained snapshot and eight captured real GEMM operand traces are mandatory. Synthetic traces, a random model, or an unavailable capture do not decide the issue.

bank_cost_grid.pair_normalized_address_envelope: For every pair, tag/address storage uses one shared format-bound product-exponent envelope across both members. Native geometry is reported separately and is not credited as an empirical-address win.

decision_rule.numeric_eligibility: For a pair, the held-out geometric-mean operand-NMSE ratio and geometric-mean dot-NMSE ratio must each be <=1.15, and neither member may exceed the other by >1.35 on more than two of eight modules.
decision_rule.routing_win: For an eligible pair, its predeclared lower-cost member must have a <=-5% paired mean total-cost delta, lower mean cost in at least six of eight modules, and a 95% paired-module-cluster bootstrap upper bound below zero in at least 75% of the fixed topology × map × lane-order × cost-preset grid.
decision_rule.validate: Validate the empirical radix-selection objective only if at least three of four frozen pairs are numerically eligible and routing wins. Report it as a workload-aware engineering selection signal, not a new CurveFP product or accumulator mechanism.
decision_rule.kill: Otherwise close #152 as unsupported: the source-sweep within-H variation did not yield a robust held-out cost-vs-error advantage.
